A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the serum factor is a novel regulator of GLUT4 translocation, and it is not affected by insulin resistance.

The main takeaway from our work is that
in insulin resistant states, such as type 2 diabetes, the ability of insulin to induce GLUT4 translocation is impaired, but the ability of another factor to do so is not.
insulin resistance is a multifactorial phenomenon, and that in the absence of insulin, the cells are capable of sensing and responding to other signals that can also regulate GLUT4 translocation.
